entries.title: Advocacy: let advocates pick their background
entries.summary: offer up to five extra backgrounds (photos, or brand color and video styles) under **Background choices for advocates** in the Designer, and each advocate picks one in their Creator console; the card they post or download uses it.

entries.title: Advocacy: export recipients with their magic links
entries.summary: **Export** on a campaign's Recipients tab downloads a CSV of everyone (or just those ticked) with engagement, tracked share link and a personal magic link per person, and copying or exporting a link no longer turns off the one you emailed.

entries.title: Advocacy: bigger headshots on short session rosters
entries.summary: roster cards with only a few speakers now size each headshot up to fill the row, stepping down as the roster grows.

entries.title: Team leads are chosen on the Evaluators step
entries.summary: session-build quotas and pre-created sessions moved from the round's settings to a **Team leads (session builds)** section on the Evaluators step, where the round's enrolled evaluators are already listed. The **Enable Reviewer Session Builds** toggle now shows the round's team lead count with a **Choose team leads in the Evaluators step** button, and the Builds tab has a **Manage team leads** link.

entries.title: Visit: map dropdown options to Visit answers
entries.summary: a **Map values** step on each dropdown or multi-select mapping row pairs every Sessionboard option with the Visit answer it registers as, auto-suggests matches even when Visit's answer names carry a bracketed prefix, and sends the answer code on sync; unmapped values are skipped and listed in that person's sync result.

entries.title: Visit: send the confirmation email on create
entries.summary: a new Event Settings switch asks Visit to email each newly created visitor its registration confirmation, once, right after the create.

entries.title: Visit: free-text questions sync
entries.summary: a text field mapped to a Visit open question now writes the text where Visit expects it, instead of failing the visitor with "Answer not found".

entries.title: Visit: single-select dropdown onto a multi-answer question
entries.summary: a single-select dropdown can now target a multi-answer Visit checkbox question; the pairing table in the guide spells out which Sessionboard field maps to which question type.

entries.title: Automations fire on every source of change
entries.summary: a field-change automation now runs whether the value was changed by an admin, a portal user, a form, an import, the Public API, or an integration writing back (for example the Visit registration ID).

entries.title: Automations: Update language value
entries.summary: a new action translates or copies a session or person field into another language enabled on the event when the record changes, filling only empty values or replacing them.

entries.title: Fill a language for many sessions at once
entries.summary: select sessions on the Sessions list or Submissions view, then choose **More** > **Update language values** to translate, or copy as-is, one text field from one enabled language into another for up to 5,000 sessions. It can fill only empty values or replace existing ones, runs in the background with progress, and doesn't trigger field-change automations.

entries.title: See which language a submission came in
entries.summary: every form submission records the language it was filled in. The session sidebar shows it next to the form name, and the Public API returns it with `expand=submission_source`.

entries.title: Dashboards hold up to 20 widgets
entries.summary: the per-dashboard widget limit is raised from 10 to 20, and the limit is enforced everywhere a widget is added, including the AI dashboard builder.
